speaker: Overlord
text: This is Overlord. A creature has hatched.

speaker: Overlord
text: It is small. It will not stay small.

speaker: Overlord
text: Kill it. Misses count against us.

speaker: Anchor
text: Good afternoon. This is Channel Nine.

speaker: Anchor
text: A creature the size of a bus has hatched.

speaker: Anchor
text: The army is on its way. So are our cameras.

speaker: Overlord
text: All squads, weapons free. Protect the city.

speaker: Overlord
text: This is it. Stand between that thing and the city.

speaker: Anchor
text: We are on the air. The creature is on the move.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature has left its egg and is now in traffic.

speaker: Overlord
text: Contact. Target is in the open.

speaker: Overlord
text: Target sighted. All squads, move in from two sides.

speaker: Granite
text: Granite has eyes on. It is in no hurry.

speaker: Beacon
text: Beacon confirms visual contact. Reporting position, as required.

speaker: Tempest
text: Tempest has the target. It will not slip away again.

speaker: Anchor
text: The army reports it has located the creature.

speaker: Anchor
text: Officials confirm soldiers can now see the creature.

speaker: Anchor
text: Army spotters now have the creature in plain view.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature has been seen again, this time by soldiers.

speaker: Granite
text: There it is. Out in the open.

speaker: Beacon
text: Target located. Position is on your map now.

speaker: Tempest
text: There you are. I see it.

speaker: Overlord
text: We have lost the target. All squads, search your sectors.

speaker: Granite
text: Lost sight of it. Somewhere in the streets.

speaker: Anchor
text: The army appears to have lost track of the creature.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature is unaccounted for. Residents are asked to check their gardens.

speaker: Tempest
text: It is hiding. I will find it.

speaker: Anchor
text: We have lost sight of the creature. So has the army.

speaker: Granite
text: Granite. Charged and ready.

speaker: Beacon
text: All weapons are charged. Awaiting your order.

speaker: Tempest
text: Tempest is charged. Give me the word.

speaker: Overlord
text: Volley is charged. Check what is behind the target.

speaker: Granite
text: Charged. Waiting on your shot.

speaker: Beacon
text: All units report full charge. You are cleared to fire.

speaker: Tempest
text: Charged and aimed. It will feel this one.

speaker: Anchor
text: Army units have stopped and appear to be taking aim.

speaker: Anchor
text: The yellow lights you see are army targeting lasers.

speaker: Anchor
text: Soldiers are holding fire. Experts say that is rarely a good sign.

speaker: Anchor
text: The army is preparing a volley. The creature may wish to brace.

speaker: Granite
text: Lasers on. Say when.

speaker: Beacon
text: Charge complete. Standing by for your order.

speaker: Tempest
text: We are charged. I want this one.

speaker: Overlord
text: Full charge. Pick your moment.

speaker: Overlord
text: Charge complete. Fire when you have a clean shot.

speaker: Overlord
text: Volley away.

speaker: Granite
text: Rounds out. Watch the fall.

speaker: Beacon
text: Volley fired. All rounds are in flight and accounted for.

speaker: Tempest
text: Tempest firing. Everything we have.

speaker: Granite
text: All of it is on the way. Should sting.

speaker: Beacon
text: Fired on your mark. Observing for effect.

speaker: Tempest
text: Firing. This one is for the city.

speaker: Anchor
text: The army has fired a coordinated volley at the creature.

speaker: Anchor
text: A full volley has just been fired. We await the results.

speaker: Anchor
text: The army has fired again. It is unclear what was hit.

speaker: Anchor
text: Another volley has been fired. Officials describe it as necessary.

speaker: Overlord
text: Fired. Watch where they land.

speaker: Overlord
text: Shots away. Start the next charge.

speaker: Granite
text: All shots out. Going again.

speaker: Beacon
text: All weapons fired. Results to follow.

speaker: Tempest
text: Everything we had. I hope it felt that.

speaker: Overlord
text: Crossfire. It is caught between you. Keep it there.

speaker: Granite
text: Two angles on it. It does not like that.

speaker: Beacon
text: Crossfire established. Exactly as the manual describes.

speaker: Tempest
text: It is trapped between us. Do not let up.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature is now taking fire from two directions.

speaker: Anchor
text: Army units have caught the creature in a crossfire, sources say.

speaker: Anchor
text: Fire is now coming from both sides. The creature seems unsure.

speaker: Anchor
text: The army now has the creature between two firing lines.

speaker: Overlord
text: Two angles on the target. Its nerve will not hold.

speaker: Granite
text: Crossfire. Keep it up.

speaker: Beacon
text: Two firing angles confirmed. Maintaining fire.

speaker: Tempest
text: Both sides now. It has nowhere to turn.

speaker: Overlord
text: Weak point is open. Fire.

speaker: Granite
text: Shoot the glowing spot. Now.

speaker: Beacon
text: Engaging the weak point, as instructed.

speaker: Tempest
text: It staggers. Give it everything.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature has stumbled. It appears badly shaken.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature seems to have lost its nerve, for the moment.

speaker: Anchor
text: The army has an opening. The creature is reeling.

speaker: Anchor
text: A glowing weak point is now visible on the creature.

speaker: Overlord
text: It is reeling. Fire.

speaker: Granite
text: Fire now. It will not last.

speaker: Beacon
text: Weak point is open. Firing now.

speaker: Tempest
text: No mercy. Everything we have.

speaker: Overlord
text: It has recovered. Weak point is closed. Reset your angles.

speaker: Granite
text: It is back up. Window is shut.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature is back on its feet and appears composed.

speaker: Anchor
text: The rampage continues. The creature has collected itself.

speaker: Tempest
text: It is up again. We will break it again.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature is standing again. It does not look pleased.

speaker: Overlord
text: It is bracing. Save your volley. Get behind it.

speaker: Tempest
text: It is bracing. Circle around behind it.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature has dug in and appears to be bracing itself.

speaker: Anchor
text: A defensive posture, experts say. The creature is holding its ground.

speaker: Beacon
text: The target is bracing. The manual says to go around.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature has lowered its head and is not moving.

speaker: Overlord
text: Steady. It is only noise. Hold your positions.

speaker: Granite
text: Loud one. Charge is gone. Starting over.

speaker: Beacon
text: The roar has reset our charge. Beginning again, per procedure.

speaker: Tempest
text: Let it scream. We are still here.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature has issued a statement. No translation is available.

speaker: Anchor
text: That sound was the creature. We apologize for the volume.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature has roared again. Windows are broken for several blocks.

speaker: Anchor
text: Soldiers near the creature appear to be reconsidering their positions.

speaker: Overlord
text: Get clear. It is charging.

speaker: Granite
text: Incoming. Get out of the way.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature is preparing something. Officials advise distance.

speaker: Anchor
text: We are told this is not normal behavior for any animal.

speaker: Beacon
text: Take cover. That is procedure.

speaker: Tempest
text: Away from it. All of you.

speaker: Anchor
text: Viewers near the creature should consider being somewhere else.

speaker: Overlord
text: Building down. That one counts against us.

speaker: Granite
text: Another one down. The skyline is getting shorter.

speaker: Beacon
text: Structure lost. Logging the address for the report.

speaker: Tempest
text: Another building gone. I will remember it.

speaker: Anchor
text: Another structure is down. Residents should make other arrangements.

speaker: Anchor
text: That building has collapsed. It was recently renovated.

speaker: Anchor
text: One more building has left the skyline.

speaker: Anchor
text: Another building is down. Insurance offices report heavy call volume.

speaker: Overlord
text: We just lost a landmark. The mayor will want names.

speaker: Beacon
text: Landmark destroyed. That one was on the postcards.

speaker: Tempest
text: That stood for a hundred years. Remember it.

speaker: Anchor
text: A city landmark has been destroyed. Tours are canceled until further notice.

speaker: Anchor
text: We have lost a landmark. It appears on our station logo.

speaker: Anchor
text: A beloved landmark is gone. The gift shop did not survive.

speaker: Overlord
text: That shot was ours. That is three forms and a hearing.

speaker: Overlord
text: We are doing its work for it. Check your backstop.

speaker: Granite
text: That one was ours. I will sign for it.

speaker: Beacon
text: We struck a building. I am required to report it. Reporting.

speaker: Tempest
text: My shot. My building. It will not happen again.

speaker: Anchor
text: That damage was caused by the army. Officials declined to comment.

speaker: Anchor
text: A stray army shot has struck a building. An inquiry is expected.

speaker: Anchor
text: The army has now hit the city it is defending.

speaker: Anchor
text: Viewers should note the creature did not do that one.

speaker: Granite
text: My mistake. Building is gone.

speaker: Beacon
text: We have damaged the city. I am starting the paperwork.

speaker: Tempest
text: I missed, and the city paid.

speaker: Overlord
text: We have lost a unit. Fill the gap and keep firing.

speaker: Granite
text: Unit down. They did their part.

speaker: Beacon
text: We have lost a unit. The time has been noted.

speaker: Tempest
text: It took one of ours. Remember that when you fire.

speaker: Anchor
text: An army unit has been lost to the creature.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature has destroyed an army unit. Its soldiers escaped, we understand.

speaker: Anchor
text: Another army unit is out of action. The creature moves on.

speaker: Anchor
text: The army has one unit fewer. The creature has not slowed.

speaker: Overlord
text: Unit down. Hold your ground.

speaker: Granite
text: One down. Not the first time.

speaker: Beacon
text: Casualty report filed. We remain in the fight.

speaker: Tempest
text: It took another. I am still counting.

speaker: Overlord
text: A full squad is gone. The rest of you, hold the line.

speaker: Overlord
text: Whole squad off the air. Fewer of you now.

speaker: Anchor
text: An entire army squad has been put out of action.

speaker: Anchor
text: One squad is gone. Its commander has joined our camera team.

speaker: Overlord
text: That squad is gone. Their sector is yours now.

speaker: Overlord
text: Squad leader is down. Next in line, you have command.

speaker: Granite
text: Lost our leader. Next in line takes over.

speaker: Beacon
text: Command has passed down the line, as the manual directs.

speaker: Overlord
text: Command passes to the next unit. Carry on.

speaker: Overlord
text: It has fed enough to grow. Watch for a cocoon.

speaker: Tempest
text: It is about to change. Do not let it rest.

speaker: Anchor
text: Experts believe the creature is now ready to grow.

speaker: Anchor
text: Scientists expect the creature to enter a cocoon at any moment.

speaker: Overlord
text: It is in a cocoon. It is helpless. Find it.

speaker: Granite
text: Follow the heartbeat. We have ten seconds.

speaker: Anchor
text: A cocoon has formed around the creature. It is not moving.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature is resting. The army is not expected to allow it.

speaker: Overlord
text: Blast wave. It is out and it is bigger. Fall back.

speaker: Beacon
text: The cocoon has opened. Target now exceeds all listed dimensions.

speaker: Anchor
text: The cocoon has burst. The creature has emerged considerably larger.

speaker: Anchor
text: A blast wave has cleared the area. The creature is out again.

speaker: Overlord
text: It is the size of a building. Bring up the heavy units.

speaker: Overlord
text: The district is the new line. All squads, redeploy.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature now stands as tall as a building. Traffic is affected.

speaker: Anchor
text: Good evening. The quarantine now covers the entire district.

speaker: Overlord
text: It is taller than the towers. The whole city is the battlefield.

speaker: Overlord
text: This is the last line. You have everything we have left.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature now stands taller than any building in the city.

speaker: Anchor
text: Night has fallen. The creature is visible from every district.

speaker: Overlord
text: Strike inbound. Keep it at the marker.

speaker: Granite
text: Heavy fire on the way. Keep it still.

speaker: Anchor
text: The army has called in a strike from outside the city.

speaker: Anchor
text: We are told to expect a heavy strike in the area shortly.

speaker: Overlord
text: Strike is on its way. Keep it where it is.

speaker: Overlord
text: Three minutes. Hold it for three minutes and the city stands.

speaker: Beacon
text: Three minutes remain on the clock. We are on schedule.

speaker: Anchor
text: The army expects to end this emergency in three minutes.

speaker: Anchor
text: Three minutes remain, and much of the city is still standing.

speaker: Overlord
text: One minute. Nobody gives ground. Nobody.

speaker: Tempest
text: Sixty seconds. It will not have this city.

speaker: Anchor
text: One minute remains. City officials are preparing a statement.

speaker: Anchor
text: We are one minute from the end of the emergency.

speaker: Overlord
text: Ten seconds. Hold.

speaker: Granite
text: Ten seconds. Almost home.

speaker: Anchor
text: Ten seconds remain.

speaker: Anchor
text: Ten seconds. The creature is almost out of time.

speaker: Overlord
text: It is hurt. It is slowing. Finish it.

speaker: Tempest
text: It is weak. Do not let it eat.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature appears unwell. Viewers are asked not to approach it.

speaker: Anchor
text: Experts suggest the creature eat something. It is badly hurt.

speaker: Overlord
text: The city cannot take much more. Stop it now.

speaker: Beacon
text: Damage totals are near the limit. This is a formal warning.

speaker: Anchor
text: Damage to the city is approaching a critical level, officials warn.

speaker: Anchor
text: City engineers say the next few buildings matter a great deal.

speaker: Overlord
text: Target is down. It is over. Well done, all of you.

speaker: Granite
text: It is not getting up. Good work.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature is dead. We now return to our regular programming.

speaker: Anchor
text: It is over. The creature has fallen and will not rise.

speaker: Overlord
text: Time. The city stands. Cease fire, all squads.

speaker: Beacon
text: The clock has run out. The city is still here.

speaker: Anchor
text: The emergency is over. The creature has run out of time.

speaker: Anchor
text: Officials have declared the city saved. Most of it remains.

speaker: Overlord
text: The city is lost. All squads, fall back. It is over.

speaker: Tempest
text: We were not enough. Remember this city.

speaker: Anchor
text: The city has fallen. This has been Channel Nine. Good night.

speaker: Anchor
text: The creature has won. We remain on the air while we can.

speaker: Chair
text: This committee finds the creature was stopped. The damage will now be itemized. Please remain seated.

speaker: Chair
text: Let the minutes show the city was saved. Let them also show what it cost.

speaker: Chair
text: The committee commends the squads. Claims for damaged property may be filed at the front desk.

speaker: Chair
text: This committee finds the city was lost. We will now determine who signs for it.

speaker: Chair
text: Let the minutes show the creature prevailed. The committee has questions for every commander in this room.

speaker: Chair
text: The committee notes the loss of the city with regret. A full accounting begins now.
